basic_info.description: Welcome to 154-156 Saturn Street, a unique SF gem boasting two updated homes on one spacious landscapted lot. Perfectly blending style and function, the front home offers 2 bedrooms & 1 bathroom, while the charming back home features 1 large bedroom and 2 baths. With a total of 2,128 Sq Ft of living space, there's plenty of room to enjoy. Step inside to discover modern upgrades throughout, including brand-new appliances and stylish fixtures that enhance both comfort and convenience. Each home is thoughtfully designed, making them ideal for versatile living or as a potential income opportunity. Step outside to a private serene garden with two inviting decks, ideal for entertaining or simply unwinding from the hustle of life. Don't miss this chance to own a property with endless possibilities in a vibrant neighborhood. Development Potential opportunity is also available! Call with questions or to see this unique property!
